text:
felix (vendor-ops): Quick lab update: a subset of H200 boards are thermal-derating under sustained 700W in dense racks. Vendor suggests region-specific power profiles for APAC.
maya (partnerships): That could change our messaging. Impact on H100/B200?
felix (vendor-ops): H100 unaffected. B200 shows derate only on older firmware builds; vendor claims patch but no hard ETA.
rui (infra): Operationally, accepting derate reduces throughput ~15%/rack. We can route bursts cross-region, but marketplace SKUs must reflect this.
claire (marketplace): Marketplace schema requires "max sustained TDP" and regional caveats. We need copy to flag APAC SKUs before listing.
diego (solutions): For SIs, publish two perf baselines: "nominal" and "derated". We'll label test artifacts accordingly so integrators choose the right profile.
ops-bot: Note: image pipeline locks new images for 72h after upload. Coordinate uploads early to avoid queue delays.
press-ops: If APAC GA is delayed, still announce NA/EU on schedule but include an "APAC rolling availability" note. Avoid language like "hardware defect"; prefer "regional thermal tuning".
maya (partnerships): Proposed: 1) NA/EU public announce May 9 with H100/H200/B200 claims. 2) APAC gets rolling availability and separate GA after patch validation. 3) Marketplace listings include expected performance windows. Agree?
rui (infra): Decision needed by May 1 to reserve lab retest slots (May 6-8). If APAC-rolling, I'll book those slots.
felix (vendor-ops): I'll push vendor for firmware patch ETA and test logs by Apr 29. If late, recommend publishing APAC with a derated baseline and updating later.
claire (marketplace): I'll draft SKU copy and region caveat template. Will include partner-packet snippet: "APAC customers: devices may operate in derated mode under sustained load; contact your SI for tuned configs."
diego (solutions): I'll draft the on-prem power-capping guide for Redwood Private customers.
maya (partnerships): Action items: vendor ETA by Apr 29 (felix), lab booking May 6-8 (rui), marketplace copy by Apr 27 (claire), SI perf baselines by Apr 26 (diego). If slips occur, escalate and prep a leak-response boilerplate.
press-ops: I'll prepare FAQ boilerplate and a kill-switch message for pausing APAC messaging.
ops-bot: Escalation trigger: if vendor ETA not posted by Apr 30, auto-create channel #hw-derate-escalation.
maya (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll update partners: NA/EU first, APAC follow-on pending validation. :white_check_mark:
